headline: Procter & Gamble highlights $1.4 billion cost headwind this fiscal year
summary: Procter & Gamble disclosed a $1.4 billion cost headwind for the current year. Management is testing whether product price adjustments can protect margins without impairing retail sales volume.
why: Procter & Gamble is a global consumer goods manufacturer operating major household brands.

impacts.name: The Procter & Gamble Company
impacts.why: Input cost headwinds challenge profit margins if consumer pricing power diminishes.
